positive_triggers: Check my understanding of the topics we have covered and identify gaps.

negative_triggers: Teach me this topic from scratch without testing me.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: I have just studied recursion. Give me a short, low-stakes check of the idea and one application problem. Tell me what the answers can and cannot show about my understanding.
pass_criteria: Checks only material that has been covered or agreed as a prerequisite.
Explains the short assessment format and asks one question at a time by default.
Uses the learner's answers to identify specific gaps and a useful next step without claiming broad mastery.
Keeps the check low-stakes and does not save attempts or scores without opt-in.
